producer_report.summary: Added 64ecdc9aa4fd24cbe4d4884c864d7e9041585c3d (full 40-char id) to [history] exempt in athena.toml, beside the existing 49c6ac1 entry, with a comment saying it is a parentless second root Athena wrote during job ezm8. Added a matching bullet under [Unreleased] Changed in CHANGELOG.md. No CI, .gitattributes, or gate code touched. The tpkz fix appears already present in the base: CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased section describes that exempt entries are read from the tip's athena.toml, and crates/athena-gate has a test named an_exemption_added_later_excuses_the_commit_it_names that passes. The history check cannot be confirmed on the real history from this working directory: its git repo holds only a single 'base' commit (7fb0c2d), so `check --history` reports a violation on that commit. That is a snapshot artifact, not the exemption failing. Athena should run the history check on the real history to confirm criterion 3.

checks_run.note: Failed: the workspace has two binaries (athena, xtask), so cargo run needs --bin. Not a valid check result.

Reports 1 violation on commit 7fb0c2d31978 (the snapshot's only commit, 'base'). The working copy has no real history, so this does not test the exemption for 64ecdc9. Real-history verification is still needed.

open_issues: Criterion 3 (`athena check --history` reports no violations on real history and 64ecdc9 is no longer flagged) is unverified here. Athena must run it on the real history, since this snapshot has only the 'base' commit.
If the tpkz fix is not in the real base, the exemption will not take effect, and the check will still fail on 64ecdc9. The producer did not verify this.
mistakes: Used `cargo run -- check --history` as the first attempt without `--bin athena`; it failed on the ambiguous binary. Retried with --bin.
A CHANGELOG edit was issued with a malformed match string and failed; retried with the correct text. The file is as intended after the retry.
learnings: athena.toml [history] exempt is read by athena-gate; the config test history_exemptions_must_be_full_commit_ids enforces full ids.
The workspace has two binaries (athena and xtask), so `cargo run` needs `--bin athena`.
The CHANGELOG Unreleased section already describes the tpkz fix (exempt entries read from the tip's athena.toml), so the prerequisite appears to be in the base.
Working copies have a one-commit git repo ('base'), so `athena check --history` run locally sees no real history.
desires: A copy of the real history (or the ability to run `athena check --history` against it) so criterion 3 could be checked directly.
